compiled_state.description:
## Context
Fault-seeding under afa0-2e15 (rival-ammoniacal-crustacean) produced two findings about
`tests/interfaces/store/test_show_no_stall.py::test_cli_show_complete_or_erroring_under_write_burst`
(8.17-8.76s local; 10.95-22.63s in CI samples — the largest variance contributor in the
default suite):

1. **It does not detect the regression it is named for.** Seeding F1 (reverting the
   slim-fetch-ledge, `_RECONVERGE_LOCK_TIMEOUT` 2 -> 15) left this test GREEN. Only the two
   held-lock tests (`test_ensure_fresh_does_not_stall_on_held_write_lock` and
   `test_reads_complete_promptly_while_write_lock_is_held`) went RED. The 15s lock wait fits
   inside this test's 60s per-subprocess harness timeout and `show` still emits a complete
   record, just slowly.
2. **Its real, exclusive detection value (seeds F3/F6 — exit 0 with a shape-valid but
   content-incomplete payload) is deterministic and fires on round 0 / ticket 0.** The F3 run
   aborted at 20.2s against a 28.9s unseeded baseline, i.e. it failed on the first iteration.

The test therefore runs 6 rounds x 4 tickets x (edit + show) = 48 CLI subprocesses under
`REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=always` to detect a fault class the first iteration already catches.

**This ticket does NOT propose deleting the test** — afa0-2e15 proved the generic property does
not subsume it (F3/F6 are caught only here). It proposes reducing the storm to what the
evidence justifies, keeping the oracle.

## Plan
- Establish, by seeding F3 and F6 at successively lower round counts, the smallest storm that
  still detects them deterministically (expected: 1-2 rounds).
- Reduce the round count to that measured floor, leaving assertions untouched.
- Re-run the full afa0-2e15 seed set (F1-F7) against the reduced test and confirm its
  detection column is unchanged.

## Testing / Verification
- Seeds F3 and F6 must still go RED at the reduced round count (repeat >= 5 runs each — the
  storm is concurrent, so a single green is not evidence of stability).
- Seeds F2 and F4 must still go RED.
- Unseeded: GREEN over >= 10 consecutive runs (guard against introducing flakiness).
- Record before/after wall-clock on macOS and in CI.
- `make lint`, `make typecheck`, `make test`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The reduced test detects every fault class it detected before (F2, F3, F4, F6).
- [ ] Detection of F3 and F6 is shown stable across repeated runs, not a single sample.
- [ ] The test is not deleted and its assertions are not weakened.
- [ ] Measured wall-clock reduction is recorded for macOS.
- [ ] Measured wall-clock reduction is recorded for CI/Ubuntu.
- [ ] No new flakiness: >= 10 consecutive unseeded GREEN runs.

file_impact.reason: Reduce the burst storm to the measured detection floor without weakening assertions.

compiled_state.title: Right-size the show-under-write-burst storm: 6 rounds buy no detection over round 0
